name: Habitat for Humanity International
story: Every **{international: cost_total / (dir_people_counted + mkt_people)|$}** helps one person abroad get better housing, and every **{us-affiliates: cost_total / people_reached|$}** gives one person in the US a built or repaired home.
summary: Builds, repairs and finances homes with low-income families through about 984 US affiliates and national organisations in more than 60 countries; buyers repay affordable mortgages.

spending.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements, fiscal year to 30 June 2025, pp. 6-7: programme services $284,497 thousand = U.S. affiliates $184,691k + international $75,514k + public awareness and education $24,292k, less donated products and advertising distributed $34,415k (US $32,286k, international $214k, public awareness $1,915k) = $250,082k in cash)

lines.label: US affiliates: homes built and sold, repairs and disaster recovery
lines.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements, FY2025, pp. 6-7): U.S. affiliates programme services $184,691 thousand, less about $2 million of US advocacy booked there (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json) and $32,286k of donated products passed on = $150,405k. Weights are cash, the money donations pay for: donated goods are the donors' resources, not HFHI's cost.

lines.label: International programme: housing with national organisations and market development
lines.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements, FY2025, pp. 6-7): international affiliates programme services $75,514 thousand, less about $1.5 million of Home Equals advocacy booked there (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json) and $214k of donated products = $73,800k in cash.

lines.label: Public awareness, education and housing-policy advocacy
lines.source: https://www.habitat.org/media/36766/download (audited consolidated statements, FY2025, pp. 6-7): public awareness and education $24,292 thousand less $1,915k of donated advertising, plus about $3.5 million of advocacy booked in the US and international programme lines (facts/habitat_for_humanity.json) = $25,877k in cash.
